summary: Final T05/G1 assessment: S06 returned five eligible pre-cutoff abstracts. S06_S2 supports broad electrostatic, stoichiometric, and salt effects on phase behavior in charged condensate models including disordered ssRNA; S06_S4 is an HP1/DNA analogy; S06_S1 is general review context. All are abstract-only and none addresses internal cavity nucleation. C_RNA_G1_PARTITION executed successfully; its conditional map reverses enrichment direction across tie-lines 1 and 2. H1 remains a provisional new internal-demixing bridge; H2 remains viable and G1 remains open.

candidates.target: Explain emergence and persistence of internal RNA-poor cavities measured by arithmetic mean per-droplet hollow-area ratio f(t), and distinguish composition-linked demixing from reaction-condition/carryover.
known_relations: f_A(0,4,8,12,24h)=0.01487,0.00544,0.00444,0.00406,0.00446; f_B=0.01381,0.01592,0.02393,0.04028,0.08918. Two preparations/condition; fields/objects are not independent preparation replicates.
C01: reference DNA read fraction 0.9466; listed non-reference sum 0.0500; total 0.9966. Repeat/rearrangement alignment is nonunique; DNA read fractions are not RNA composition or active valence.
E02: endpoint hollow-area means M near 0, M+L 0.04446, M+S 0.09412; exact mixture ratios, RNA yields, and matched carryover are absent.

C04: K_reference/K_variant are 238.54/9032.08 on tie-line 1 and 525.12/176.01 on line 2; variant K on line 0 undefined because dilute variant concentration is zero. Error rectangles are marginal, not confidence intervals.
C_RNA_G1_PARTITION executed, returncode 0: conditional map xV^L=0.01 -> xV^D=0.27665 on line 1 but 0.00337 on line 2. Enrichment direction reverses across tie-lines.
C03 lacks persistent same-droplet cavity-area/state trajectories. C04 lacks phase volumes, time-resolved production/flux, and cavity-matched spatial concentrations.

S06_S2 (2025-02-11, abstract only) describes a charge-informed model for charge-rich condensates including disordered ssRNA; reports charge-blockiness, stoichiometry and salt effects on modeled phase behavior, with agreement to experiments. This is broad phase-behavior support, not an internal-cavity law.
S06_S4 (2024-04-09, abstract only) reports sequence charge-distribution effects on HP1 LLPS and DNA competition effects on stability; protein/DNA analogy only.
S06_S1 (2024-10-01, abstract-only review) describes RNA/RBP condensation and notes determinants have been studied from a protein-centric perspective; no constitutive relation.

hypotheses.status: new provisional hypothesis; retained after literature and conditional-computation review
hypotheses.statement: If transcription produces RNA populations with different effective interaction valence, selective partitioning may shift local composition across a coexistence boundary inside an initially RNA-rich condensate. The explicitly new, unverified bridge is that this shift can nucleate and stabilize an internal RNA-poor phase, causing per-droplet hollow-area ratio to rise after a local composition threshold.
hypotheses.status_note: S06_S2 supports broad phase-behavior sensitivity in charged RNA-containing condensate models, but not internal cavities. C04 conditional maps reverse direction across tie-lines. No evidence links listed DNA variants to RNA yield, valence, cavity partition, or image area.

hypotheses.statement: Amplification-associated carryover or another changed reaction condition alters transcription, ionic environment, or condensate organization without sequence composition mediating the hollow-area change.

gaps.description: No eligible source or supplied measurement provides a constitutive relation from mixed RNA composition and selective partitioning to internal demixing, cavity nucleation/persistence, or observed area ratio. Retrieved abstracts support broader phase behavior or cross-system analogies only.
No matched time-resolved measurement connects template composition to transcribed RNA composition; DNA read frequencies cannot substitute for RNA concentrations.
No validated map connects f to phase volume, local concentration, or same-droplet cavity dynamics.

variables_units.name: f
variables_units.meaning: arithmetic mean of per-droplet hollow area divided by filled area

variables_units.name: x_V^L
variables_units.meaning: variant RNA mass fraction in dilute phase on a fixed assay basis

variables_units.name: x_V^D
variables_units.meaning: variant RNA mass fraction in dense phase on same basis

variables_units.name: c_i^D
variables_units.meaning: RNA species i concentration in dense phase

variables_units.name: c_i^L
variables_units.meaning: RNA species i concentration in dilute phase

variables_units.name: phi
variables_units.meaning: latent internal RNA-poor phase volume fraction

equations: K_i=c_i^D/c_i^L when c_i^L>0; otherwise K_i is undefined.
Closed two-species equilibrium mixture on one applicable tie-line: x_V^D=K_V*x_V^L/[K_V*x_V^L+K_R*(1-x_V^L)].
Inverting for a hypothesized dense-phase threshold x_star: x_V,L*=x_star*K_R/[K_V*(1-x_star)+x_star*K_R]. This maps a chosen threshold only; it does not predict that one exists.
H1 phenomenology: phi=0 below x_star and phi>0 may occur at/above x_star. This is an unestimated hypothesis, not a supplied constitutive law.
Unknown observation map: f=h(phi,cavity geometry,droplet selection,segmentation); f cannot be equated with phi.

parameters_ranges.name: K_R and K_V
parameters_ranges.range: Use only C04 tie-line-specific estimates and marginal error rectangles; do not pool lines or call rectangles confidence intervals.

initial_boundary_conditions: Similar t=0 group means do not establish equal microscopic state or RNA composition.
H1 conditionally assumes initial local composition below x_star; unobserved.
Time-varying RNA production, phase volumes, phase fluxes, and cavity boundary conditions unavailable.
observation_mapping: f is a mean of object-level image area ratios, not concentration, phase volume fraction, or free energy.
C04 concentrations cannot be converted to f without cavity-matched concentrations, geometry, and phase volumes.
Field SEM and object counts do not estimate preparation-level uncertainty.
alternatives: H2: carryover or reaction conditions alter transcription or condensate organization without sequence mediation.
Population selection, coalescence, or detection changes may alter aggregate f; C03 cannot test persistent cavity states.
Segmentation or sampling effects may alter f; threshold robustness is unavailable.
Equal partition K_V=K_R gives x_V^D=x_V^L and removes enrichment/depletion in the conditional identity.

predictions.statement: At fixed reaction chemistry and total RNA production, increasing directly measured variant RNA fraction across a threshold should increase cavity-bearing-droplet probability or object-level hollow-area ratio under H1. H2 predicts no systematic variant-fraction dependence after carryover and reaction chemistry are matched.
predictions.measure: Controlled RNA composition series with direct RNA composition, per-droplet hollow-area ratios, matched carryover, independent preparations.
predictions.limitation: Prospective only; existing length-fraction endpoints are not a controlled composition series.

predictions.statement: C04 central values under closed-mixture assumptions: line 1 maps xV^L=0.01 to xV^D=0.27665 and xV^D=0.5 to xV^L=0.02573; line 2 maps xV^L=0.01 to xV^D=0.00337 and xV^D=0.5 to xV^L=0.74896. Threshold mapping therefore depends on tie-line; no universal direction follows.
predictions.limitation: Endpoint K values have broad marginal error rectangles; transferability, equilibrium, closed two-species mixture, and common mass/mole basis are unverified. Predicts neither cavities nor f.

checks: Concentrations ng/uL; K, compositions, x_star, phi, and f dimensionless.
Line 0 variant K undefined and no value imputed.
Broker execution returncode 0; unit interval, endpoint, and equal-K identity checks passed.
Equal-K limit gives x_V^D=x_V^L; x_V^L endpoints map to themselves.
Partition identity assumes closed two-species equilibrium and does not close dynamic mass balance or predict cavity onset.
Computed phase compositions are not cavity-specific and have no mapping to f.
S06_S1-S06_S5 are abstracts only; no full-text theorem or system-specific cavity mechanism assessed.
evidence_conflicts: E02 is compatible with length-class dependence but does not isolate composition from carryover, exact mixture fraction, or RNA yield.
C04 reverses partitioning direction between lines 1 and 2 and lacks cavity-specific measurements.
S06_S2 supports broad RNA-containing charged-condensate phase behavior but no internal cavities; S06_S4 is a protein/DNA analogy.
S05 and S_RNA_G1_1 returned no eligible abstracts. S06 returned five eligible abstracts of 95 hits, none directly addressing internal cavity nucleation.

Whether variants change effective valence or internal coexistence.
Whether internal dark regions are a distinct RNA-poor phase.

dissent: Do not treat conditional partition results or broad phase-separation literature as confirmation that H1 explains the cavities; H2 and measurement/population alternatives remain viable.

Next, run a composition series at matched reaction chemistry/carryover and total RNA production, with direct RNA composition, phase-resolved concentrations, and longitudinal per-droplet cavity state/area in independent preparations.

final.question_and_reason: Does selective partitioning of a mixed transcribed RNA population cause an internal RNA-poor phase and increasing B hollow-area ratio? This is the missing bridge between sequence/length heterogeneity, endpoint phase partitioning, and the image phenotype.
final.increment: Retrieved literature gives limited support for composition/electrostatic control of phase behavior in charged RNA-containing condensate models and an HP1/DNA analogy; neither reaches internal cavities. Conditional computation using C04 shows that dense-phase enrichment can be strong or reversed depending on tie-line.
final.new_hypotheses: H1: if transcribed RNA species differ in effective interaction valence, selective partitioning can shift local composition across a coexistence boundary and nucleate/stabilize an internal RNA-poor phase. The internal-cavity bridge is explicitly new and untested. H2 remains a viable reaction-condition/carryover alternative.
final.actual_derivation_or_computation: C_RNA_G1_PARTITION executed with returncode 0 using phase_measurements.json. For x_V^D=K_V*x_V^L/[K_V*x_V^L+K_R*(1-x_V^L)], line 1 (K_V=9032.08,K_R=238.54) maps x_V^L=0.01 to x_V^D=0.27665 and x_V^D=0.5 to x_V^L=0.02573. Line 2 (K_V=176.01,K_R=525.12) maps x_V^L=0.01 to x_V^D=0.00337 and x_V^D=0.5 to x_V^L=0.74896. Unit interval, endpoint, and equal-K checks passed. Conditional equilibrium composition arithmetic only, not a cavity computation.
final.discriminating_prediction: With reaction chemistry/carryover and total RNA production matched, increasing directly quantified variant RNA fraction across a candidate threshold should raise cavity-bearing-droplet probability or per-droplet hollow-area ratio under H1. H2 predicts no systematic variant-fraction dependence after matching. Prospective only.
final.evidence_support_conflict_untested: B f rises 0.01381 to 0.08918 from 0 to 24 h; E02 length-fraction endpoints differ; C04 has species-specific partition ratios; S06_S2 supports broad phase behavior in RNA-containing condensate models. Limits: two preparations, DNA frequency is not RNA composition, E02 lacks carryover matching and exact composition, C04 reverses direction across tie-lines and lacks cavity-specific measurements, retrieved abstracts give no cavity mechanism, and f is not concentration or phase volume fraction. Same-droplet cavity trajectories are absent.
final.decision: Complete the literature assessment and conditional partition derivation; retain H1 as provisional and keep G1 open. No mechanism is established and H2 is not ruled out.
final.dissent: Do not treat broad phase-separation literature or conditional partition enrichment as confirmation that RNA mixture demixing causes the observed cavities.
final.next_experiment: Run a randomized variant-RNA composition series with matched carryover, salt/ionic conditions, and total RNA production; quantify RNA composition and phase-resolved concentrations directly, then longitudinally track per-droplet cavity appearance and area across independent preparations.
final.limitations: All retrieved literature evidence is abstract-only; no target-specific full text or internal-cavity relation was retrieved. Partition calculations assume closed two-species equilibrium and tie-line transferability and do not map to f. No physical experiment or empirical confirmation was performed.
